name: PadPort
meaning: the port argument of Pad::Open 0x55f0a8: the PlayStation libpad port id (port << 4); Input_Init opens g_pad on port 1 and g_pad2 on port 2. The PC Pad::Open ignores it

name: PAD_PORT_1
meaning: the first controller port (g_pad) (inferred from the libpad convention)

name: PAD_PORT_2
meaning: the second controller port (g_pad2) (inferred from the libpad convention)
